transcript.speaker: Scammer
transcript.text: Hey beautiful, I've been thinking about you all day. You're the only one who truly understands me.

transcript.speaker: Victim
transcript.text: Aw, that's sweet. I've been thinking about you too.

transcript.speaker: Scammer
transcript.text: I need to tell you something. There's been an emergency with my offshore account — I'm stranded and can't access my funds. I'm scared.

transcript.speaker: Victim
transcript.text: Oh no, what happened? Are you okay?

transcript.speaker: Scammer
transcript.text: The bank froze everything. I only need $2,000 to get the release fee and I can fly home to be with you. This is urgent — they said I have 24 hours or I lose everything.

transcript.speaker: Victim
transcript.text: That sounds serious. Can't your family help?

transcript.speaker: Scammer
transcript.text: Please don't tell anyone about this. I'm embarrassed and I don't want my family to know about my situation. You're the only one I trust. Just between us, okay?

transcript.speaker: Victim
transcript.text: I understand. I just want to make sure you're safe.

transcript.speaker: Scammer
transcript.text: After everything we've shared, everything I've done for you... I just need you to help me one time. I'm suffering here alone and I'm afraid.

transcript.speaker: Victim
transcript.text: I... I don't know. It's a lot of money.

transcript.speaker: Scammer
transcript.text: Act now please. The deadline is tonight. I can't lose you and my freedom at the same time. I love you.
